disclosure: This is a first-party, AI-assisted proof record. The public files support integrity checking, schema checking, and claim-to-record tracing; they do not independently authenticate the withheld private telemetry or reproduce the private implementation.

claims.statement: Identified instrumented runs recorded nonzero translated-path audio samples, host conversion, and operating-system delivery on the exercised path.
failure_criteria: The underlying run record lacks nonzero translated-path samples.
The record does not show host conversion or operating-system delivery.
A retained record contradicts one of the summarized facts.
limitations: The claim does not establish physical audibility, accuracy, timing, or fidelity.

claims.statement: A sanitized audit of one examined configuration recorded 7180 mapped entries, 7103 declarations, 7046 generated definitions, 57 runtime-supplied declarations, 71 C translation units, 74 generated files totaling 37708847 bytes, 70 overlay sections, and 7100 overlay entries.
failure_criteria: Any public count differs from the retained private audit for the identified configuration.
The declaration partition does not consist of 7046 generated definitions plus 57 runtime-supplied declarations.
Mapped entries, declarations, definitions, or overlay entries are presented as the same audit population.
limitations: The record does not establish a one-for-one generated definition for every mapped entry.
Reachability, relocations, jump tables, reviewed exceptions, and complete inventory closure remain incomplete.

claims.statement: Physical button and analog input reached the host integration on the exercised path, and rumble commands were recorded without a host-side failure in the observed run.
failure_criteria: The retained record lacks physical button or analog input.
The retained record shows a host-side rumble failure that the summary omits.
The recorded input did not occur while the private program progressed.
limitations: The claim does not cover every binding, device, or multi-controller configuration.

claims.statement: One detached run recorded a window-close reason, 622 VI callbacks, 621 screen updates, 609 display-list submissions, and the planned subsystem teardown sequence.
failure_criteria: Any transcribed counter differs from the retained private log.
The private log lacks the stated window-close reason.
The private log omits or contradicts a stated teardown event.
limitations: This is a run-specific telemetry claim and does not establish reference fidelity or all shutdown paths.

claims.statement: The later graphical recheck did not pass its stated activity threshold, and the cause of the shortfall remains unresolved.
failure_criteria: The retained recheck records show that every stated trial met the 160-submission threshold.
The reported default-path stall did not occur.
A definitive cause is established but the claim continues to label it unresolved.
limitations: The failed recheck does not by itself invalidate earlier artifact-bound records.
The package cannot independently establish the cause because private logs are withheld.

claims.statement: One accepted 15-second scripted run traversed generic menu, intro, and battle phases and recorded 901 VI callbacks, 901 screen updates, and 726 display-list submissions.
failure_criteria: Any counter differs from the retained private telemetry for the identified run.
The scripted route did not enter the summarized intro and battle phases.
The result is attributed to a later artifact generation or acceptance session rather than this exact run.
limitations: The counters do not establish rendered-pixel correctness or reference fidelity.
Internal scene identifiers, screenshots, frame captures, and a pixel oracle are not public.
This exact-run result must remain distinct from later generations and the failed recheck.

claims.statement: For the examined configuration and execution path, inspection supports a bounded inference that the guest-CPU path used ahead-of-time host code; no guest-CPU interpreter or guest-CPU just-in-time compiler was identified there.
failure_criteria: An active guest-CPU interpreter or guest-CPU just-in-time compiler is identified in the examined path.
The inspected artifact does not contain the reported ahead-of-time host code.
Reachability evidence contradicts the bounded inspection result.
limitations: Executable inventory and reachability accounting are incomplete.
Graphics and platform compatibility services remain present.
The inference cannot be generalized beyond the examined configuration and path.

claims.statement: The participant reported completing one route through its final encounter and post-route challenge, then finding one new unlock still available after restart.
failure_criteria: The participant withdraws or materially corrects the summarized account.
The contemporaneous private session record contradicts the attributed statement.
The statement is presented as instrumented or independently witnessed proof rather than attestation.
limitations: The session was an unstructured first-party acceptance run.
The attestation covers only the exercised route and one persisted unlock state.

claims.statement: AI-assisted live inspection identified the credits, an unlock notice, and a later normal-close launcher message on the exercised path.
failure_criteria: The contemporaneous private session record lacks one of the stated observations.
A retained image or session record contradicts the summarized observation.
The claim is presented as re-inspectable visual evidence despite the absence of retained screenshots.
limitations: No screenshot was retained, so the public package cannot independently re-inspect the screens.
These observations do not establish the participant's full route account or post-restart selectable state.

claims.statement: Source inspection and dedicated tests exercised the examined settings and launcher contract with an isolated disposable fake child, including held-path identity, argument and environment policy, descriptor closure, lifecycle handling, and marker-symlink rejection.
failure_criteria: The dedicated contract test supplied or executed the private game rather than its fake child.
A listed check was not exercised by source inspection and the dedicated tests.
The retained test result contradicts the summarized pass.
limitations: This is a fake-child source-and-test result, not live-game behavior.
It is not syscall monitoring, sandbox evidence, or filesystem-wide proof against transient copies.

claims.statement: The cause of the earlier orphaned game process ending remains unresolved because its final process status was unavailable.
failure_criteria: A trustworthy final game-process status and causal record are recovered.
The game was not actually observed running after the process-control session ended.
The process-control status is incorrectly presented as the game's final status.
limitations: The evidence supports neither a crash nor a non-crash conclusion.
External session cleanup is only a working hypothesis.

claims.statement: The public standard-library verifier passed its valid baseline and rejected the exercised tampering, inventory, unsafe-path, evidence-linkage, status, scope, overreach, and negative-run suppression cases.
failure_criteria: The published test suite does not pass against the exact published capsule.
A named adverse fixture is accepted by the verifier.
The valid unmodified capsule is rejected by the verifier.
limitations: The tests cover only their enumerated cases and do not prove the verifier defect-free.
Verifier behavior does not authenticate the truth of withheld evidence.
